newsitem.title: JAPAN: IZUMIYA ASK-ONLY ON REVISED FORECAST.
newsitem.headline: IZUMIYA ASK-ONLY ON REVISED FORECAST.

text.p: Shares in Izumiya Co Ltd were ask-only on Thursday morning due to the supermarket operator's downward revision of its earnings forecast announced on Wednesday, traders said.
As of 0022 GMT, the shares were ask-only at 1,330 yen against Wednesday's 1,350 yen.
On Wednesday, Izumiya said it had revised its forecast of parent current profits for the six months to August 31, 1997, to 3.05 billion yen from its previous forecast of 6.10 billion yen.
Izumiya also now expects parent current profits for the year to February 28, 1998, of 5.20 billion yen against its previous forecast of 10.50 billion yen.
